review_criteria.conditional_ranking: One descriptive frozen-score comparison: max(Q_LONG,Q_SHORT)-Q_FLAT, chosen side argmax(LONG,SHORT); top versus bottom half within each TRAIN month, stable parent-ID ties, upper half ceil(n/2). Compare same rows against always LONG. No cutpoint search, threshold adjustment or fitting. Reused TRAIN evidence only; no generalization claim.
review_criteria.entry_policy: Report actual Entry choices and one-position marked economics separately from hypothetical BOTH-side opportunities. Future best sides or profitable rows are never admissible Entry inputs.
review_criteria.interpretation: Complete finite accounting is required. Positive counterfactual means do not prove a causal Entry strategy; negative side means alone do not rule out conditional edge. Report variation across all months, not selected winners.
review_criteria.next_decision: Keep the learning gate unpassed unless improved causal Entry and Exit choices are established. Separately bind any later chronological check; no full epoch/VAL, CONTROL/TEST, trading, spending, cost change or teacher refresh.
review_criteria.open_positions: Include every open position at its last executable liquidation value plus cashflows. The TRAIN cutoff is an observation boundary, never a forced model EXIT or maximum holding rule. Unknown source gaps remain non-authoritative and reported separately.
review_criteria.paired_baselines: Same-entry immediate executable EXIT with identical quotes and costs, plus FLAT0. Aggregate and per-side/per-month net Bps, differences, decisions, and closed/open counts. Relative improvement alone is not positive edge.
review_criteria.population: Exact existing TRAIN256, both counterfactual sides, all nine calendar months, in chronological order. No new selection or target fitting.
review_criteria.question: Does the complete frozen ONLINE512 Exit policy preserve its conditional TRAIN improvement through consecutive decisions under the unchanged executable BID/ASK and slippage policy?
review_criteria.resource_stop: One native three-hour observation window; any exhausted wall/forward/state budget is INCOMPLETE, not an economic rejection or completed evaluation. No automatic extension or relaunch.
